WUSA9 (Washington, D.C.) is your source for breaking news, D.C. area weather, traffic, and live coverage in the nation’s capital and surrounding communities. Get the latest updates from the WUSA9 team — from major local headlines and investigations to severe weather, community stories, and the moments everyone’s talking about.
Watch live newscasts, stream breaking coverage, and catch up on the top stories shaping Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia, and suburban Maryland.

Subscribe for:
• D.C. area breaking news + live updates
• Weather forecasts and severe weather alerts
• Investigations and accountability reporting
• Community stories across the region
• Major events, sports, and local explainers

WUSA9 — Washington, D.C. news and weather, live and on demand.

🔗 More: https://www.wusa9.com
🔗 Stream on your TV: https://www.tv.wusa9.com
